subject: trouble in using the element in the checkboxGroupInput in if statement

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: trouble in using the element in the checkboxGroupInput in if statement
parts:
Hi, 
I created a checkboxGroupInput in ui as
                                               
checkboxGroupInput('plot','Parameters~covariates', list('continuous'='A','categorical'='B')).

and in server, I wrote a reactive conductor using an if statement

plot1<-reactive({
 p <- ggplot(dt, aes_string(x=input$x, y=input$y)) 
if(input$plot=='A') {
p<-p+geom_point() }
if(input$plot=='B') {
p<-p+geom_boxplot()}
return (p)
}

When running, it gave me an error msg saying" ERROR in if (input$plot == 'A') { : argument is of length zero 

Any suggestion on this? Thanks

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: trouble in using the element in the checkboxGroupInput in if statement
parts:
you need to first check if it's null

e.g

if(is.null(input$plot)) {
 return()
} else if (input$plot  == 'A') { 
  ...something else ...

}
